description: This file defines a utility module for making API calls using fetch with support for authentication headers and common HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). It exports an 'api' object with asynchronous methods for each HTTP verb.
external_files: fetch (built-in browser API for HTTP requests)

methods.name: getAuthHeaders()
methods.description: Generates authorization headers if a token is stored in local storage.

methods.name: api.get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL with optional additional options.

methods.name: api.post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body.

methods.name: api.put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON body.
